entities.summary: Natalia María Málaga Dibos, more commonly known as Natalia Málaga, is a former volleyball player and coach from Peru. Málaga participated in four Summer Olympics with the Peruvian women's national volleyball team. She placed sixth in 1980 in Moscow, fourth in 1984 in Los Angeles, won a silver medal in 1988 in Seoul, and placed eleventh in 2000 in Sydney. Natalia Málaga was a athletes & competitors from Lima (b. 1964-01-26, Lima). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
